checks.name: recorded orphan preview is read-only and respects grace period
abandoned object removed with durable completion and failed-material recovery state
registered manifest/task destination is excluded from orphan deletion
manifest reconciliation protects files after lost registration acknowledgement
registration failure rolls back manifest/task and leaves original intent available for cleanup
Storage fault retains intent with sanitized error and backoff; retry is idempotent
stale token and authenticated direct write denied; another owner has no candidates
real PostgreSQL lock stays held after graph timeout until uncancellable background IO actually ends
cooperative graph timeout cancels work and releases the real owner transaction
subject and privacy deletion include pending destinations; export includes intents

scope: local SQL/Storage/real PostgreSQL owner lock; injected graph coroutine, no model/ASR/graph provider
limitations: no continuous Beat or multi-host fault injection
uncancellable providers can keep owner busy until they finish
